(()=>{const s=ctw.scene; const before=[s.round.tell.id, s.sheep.length]; ctw.go('title'); ctw.go('play'); const t=ctw.scene; const after=[t.round.tell.id, t.sheep.length]; return {test:'round persists', before, after, ok: before[0]===after[0] && before[1]===after[1]}})()

(()=>{ctw.save.data.pelts=7; const s=ctw.scene; const n=s.sheep.find(x=>!x.isWolf); s.pointer({type:'down',x:n.x,y:n.y,id:1}); const d=ctw.save.data; return {test:'press your luck: miss loses all pelts', pelts:d.pelts, streak:d.streak, ring: !!s.ring, ok: d.pelts===0 && d.streak===0 && !!s.ring}})()
(async()=>{const r=await import('./js/art/render.js'); const look={wool:'cream',face:'cream',tells:{tail:true}}; return {test:'tail hit', ok: r.sheepHitScore(look,0,0,1,0,-12,72) <= 1}})()

(async()=>{const R=await import('./js/game/rules.js'); const P=await import('./js/art/palette.js'); let bad=0, tints=0, maxBreeds=0; for(let i=0;i<3000;i++){const r=R.makeRound(18); const w=r.sheep.find(s=>s.isWolf); const wools=[...new Set(r.sheep.filter(s=>!s.isWolf).map(s=>s.look.breed))]; maxBreeds=Math.max(maxBreeds,wools.length); if(w.look.tells.tint){tints++; const fake=P.tintPalette(P.WOOL[w.look.wool],w.look.tells.tint).base; for(const b of R.db.breeds) if(b.inRounds && b.look.wool!==w.look.wool && P.colorDistance(fake,P.WOOL[b.look.wool].base)<12) bad++;}} return {test:'colour wolves never match another breed', tints, bad, maxBreeds, ok: bad===0 && tints>0 && maxBreeds>=3}})()
(async()=>{const R=await import('./js/game/rules.js'); const c={}; for(let i=0;i<3000;i++){const t=R.makeRound(18).tell.id; c[t]=(c[t]||0)+1;} return {test:'full moon tell mix', c}})()
(()=>{const d=ctw.save.data; d.streak=18; d.pelts=50; delete d.round; ctw.go('play'); return 'hard round'})()
(()=>{const s=ctw.scene; window._pos=s.sheep.map(x=>[x.x,x.y]); return {n:s.sheep.length}})()

(()=>{const s=ctw.scene; const moved=s.sheep.filter((x,i)=>Math.hypot(x.x-_pos[i][0],x.y-_pos[i][1])>4).length; let worst=0; for(const a of s.sheep) for(const b of s.sheep){ if(a===b) continue; for(const p of a.circles()) for(const q of b.circles()){ const o=(p.r+q.r)-Math.hypot(p.x-q.x,p.y-q.y); if(o>worst) worst=o; } } const inside=s.sheep.every(x=>x.x>=s.field.x && x.x<=s.field.x+s.field.w && x.y>=s.field.y && x.y<=s.field.y+s.field.h); return {test:'sheep wander, no overlaps, stay in field', moved, of:s.sheep.length, worstOverlapPx:+worst.toFixed(1), inside, ok: moved>=3 && worst<3 && inside}})()

(()=>{const s=ctw.scene; const counts=[s.live().length]; for(let i=0;i<8;i++){ s.useHint(); counts.push(s.live().length); } const wolfLeft=s.live().some(x=>x.isWolf); const saved=ctw.save.data.round.sheep.length; return {test:'sniff halves down to 2', counts, wolfLeft, saved, ok: s.live().length===2 && wolfLeft && saved===2}})()
(()=>{ctw.go('title'); ctw.go('play'); const s=ctw.scene; return {test:'sniffed flock persists', n:s.sheep.length, ok: s.sheep.length===2}})()

(()=>{const farm=[]; for(let i=0;i<24;i++) farm.push({uid:i+1,breed:i%3?'white':'lamb',name:'S'+i,x:0.2+(i%6)*0.12,y:0.2+Math.floor(i/6)*0.15}); const d=ctw.save.data; d.farm=farm; d.pelts=40; d.nextUid=30; d.pantry={}; d.toys=[]; d.foods=[]; ctw.save.write(); ctw.go('shop'); document.querySelector('[data-buy=brown]').click(); const b=document.querySelector('.banner'); return {test:'shop full banner', ok: !!b && /full/i.test(b.textContent)}})()

(()=>{const s=ctw.scene; document.querySelector('[data-food=hay]').click(); const a=s.area; const open=[[0.45,0.55],[0.5,0.62],[0.4,0.7],[0.6,0.7],[0.5,0.4]].map(([u,v])=>[a.x+a.w*u,a.y+a.h*v]).find(([x,y])=>!s.world.avoid.some(o=>Math.hypot(o.x-x,o.y-y)<o.r+24*s.sc)); s.pointer({type:'down',x:open[0],y:open[1],id:3}); s.pointer({type:'up',x:open[0],y:open[1],id:3}); return {test:'place hay', foods:s.foods.length, pantry:ctw.save.data.pantry.hay, seekers:s.sheep.filter(x=>x.state==='seek'||x.food).length, ok: s.foods.length===1 && ctw.save.data.pantry.hay===0}})()
(()=>{const s=ctw.scene; const t=s.toys[0]; window._t=[t.x,t.y]; s.pointer({type:'down',x:t.x,y:t.y,id:4}); s.pointer({type:'up',x:t.x,y:t.y,id:4}); return 'flicked'})()

(()=>{const s=ctw.scene; const t=s.toys[0]; const eaters=s.foods[0]?s.foods[0].eaters.size:0; const left=s.foods[0]?+s.foods[0].remaining.toFixed(1):0; return {test:'sheep eat (max 6 seats), toy rolls', eaters, left, toyMoved:+Math.hypot(t.x-_t[0],t.y-_t[1]).toFixed(0), ok: eaters>=3 && eaters<=6 && left<300 && Math.hypot(t.x-_t[0],t.y-_t[1])>20}})()
